Exicom Power Solutions B.V.,Netherlands, is a wholly owned subsidiary ("WOS") of the Company, incorporated on 08/01/2024. On August 05, 2024, the Company approved an investment of upto Rs. 470 crores, in one or more tranches, through subscription of shares or any other permissible mode subject to compliance of applicable law.
On 6th November, 2025, the Company completed its fourth tranche investment by subscribing to 15,15,500 ordinary shares, at Euro 1 each, totalling to EURO 15,15,500 (equivalent to Rs. 15,47,21,184/-), for which the Company had also submitted the intimation under Regulation 30 of SEBI LODR Regulations, to the stock exchnages, on the same day.
With this remittance, the Company continues to hold 100% of the subsidiarys share capital.
